annotation.justification: The clause unambiguously requires each endpoint to maintain at least eight connection IDs, and the phrase “provide and maintain” applies to that same set of IDs. No alternative materially different implementation behaviours are supported by the wording, and no missing constraint prevents a unique operational interpretation.
